meta.rule: All figures are arithmetic on published inputs captured 2026-11-11. Boards are reference rates carrying the publisher's own disclaimer, so every total is a LOWER BOUND. Blank = the input is not published and was not inferred.
meta.tiers_note: USD amount is the amount the beneficiary should receive; CNY needed is computed at the bank's published selling rate.

BOC.label: Bank of China (electronic banking personal tariff)
BOC.note: 1 per mille, min CNY 50 / max CNY 260, plus CNY 150 cable for non-HK/Macao/Taiwan.

HSBC_PREMIER.label: HSBC China - Premier
HSBC_PREMIER.note: Prepaid as 0.1%, min CNY 100 / max CNY 500 (item 2.2.4.1) plus CNY 120 cable (item 2.2.4.2).

HSBC_PRIVATE.label: HSBC China - Private Banking
HSBC_PRIVATE.note: Individual customer: telegraphic transfer issuance free, cable free (items 2.2.4.1-2.2.4.2). Tariff note 7 excludes other institutions' charges.

HSBC_GLOBAL.label: HSBC China - Global Transfer to own overseas HSBC account
HSBC_GLOBAL.note: Item 2.2.6.1: free for Private Banking and Premier; Advance is USD 20 actual per transaction (CNY 145 indicative).

reconversion.note: Emigrant/inheritance transfer of the equivalent of CNY 200,000 or less may be remitted in one go after approval; above that it is staged over two years and above CNY 500,000 needs SAFE headquarters approval.

illo_6227_gain.rule: gain exceeds USD 200; 988(e)(2) exclusion does not apply; ordinary treatment under 988(a)(1)(A)

illo_50k_gain.rule: gain exceeds USD 200; 988(e)(2) exclusion does not apply; ordinary treatment under 988(a)(1)(A)

illo_400k_gain.rule: gain exceeds USD 200; 988(e)(2) exclusion does not apply; ordinary treatment under 988(a)(1)(A)

illo_small_gain.rule: gain does not exceed USD 200; personal-transaction exclusion applies

prc_iit.note: PRC IIT Law Art. 3: comprehensive income 3%-45%; interest, dividends, rent, property transfer 20%. A tax on the income, not on the conversion.
